owner_calls.question: The text and card lines say Kang nearly wiped out Veb's species, but that backstory is not on screen. Keep the tie with a rewrite to what Quantumania shows (Kang's Quantumnauts capture and imprison Veb with the Freedom Fighters, and he fights in the uprising against Kang at Chronopolis)? Note Veb never deals with Kang face to face; the tie rests on the Freedom Fighters' war with Kang, so it stays under the unsure rule.
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU wiki sources Veb's species being wiped out by Kang only to an exclusive interview on The Direct ('Veb's Unseen, Tragic Backstory'), not the film. On screen Veb is captured by Quantumnauts and M.O.D.O.K. and fights Quantumnauts in the Battle of Chronopolis while Kang fights Ant-Man and the Wasp.
